name: BaseName Commerce
tagline: Turn basenames into AI-readable storefronts with Base checkout.
mission: Let merchants map a basename to products, checkout metadata, and MCP purchase flows for human and agent buyers.
workflow: Merchant connects Base Account and claims a storefront profile.
Basename resolves to a catalog and checkout metadata.
Agent presents purchasable items to the user.
User approval settles the order in USDC on Base.
